purpose: Teach: 閉塞/南方/先駆け/先取り/英訳/下宿/検知/絶叫

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、血管閉塞、つまり閉塞性脳卒中の症例を医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Ren, the medical team will be handling this case of vascular blockage — an occlusive stroke.
lines.style: Calm clinical briefing, unhurried, each term enunciated cleanly with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、南方諸島の熱帯医療経験を医療チームで共有します
lines.en: Ren, the team will be sharing its tropical-medicine experience from the southern islands.
lines.style: Even and warm-clinical, a slight lift of interest on the specialty.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新治療の先駆け、つまり先駆け症例を医療チームで報告します
lines.en: Ren, the team will be reporting a pioneering case — the first of its kind under the new treatment.
lines.style: A trace of professional pride surfacing, pace steady, emphasis resting on pioneering.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、感染予防の先取り対応を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, the team will be taking preemptive steps on infection prevention — getting ahead of it.
lines.style: Brisker and purposeful, the preventive point delivered with firm forward momentum.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医学論文の英訳を医療チームで共同で進めます
lines.en: Ren, the team will be working together on the English translation of the medical paper.
lines.style: Relaxed collegial tone, softer than the clinical items, inviting rather than instructing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦前下宿で起きた集団感染史を医療チームで紐解きます
lines.en: Ren, the team will be tracing the history of the mass infection that struck a prewar lodging house.
lines.style: Slower and more reflective, the historical weight given room to breathe.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新型検知器、つまり検知装置を医療チームで導入します
lines.en: Ren, the team will be bringing in the new detector — the detection equipment.
lines.style: Crisp and practical again, a small note of satisfaction about the upgrade.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の絶叫、つまり絶叫的反応に医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Ren, the team will be responding to patients' screaming — those extreme distress reactions.
lines.style: Gentler, voice lowering with care, the closing line held steady and humane.
